source.name: Al-Fayha Club: الفيحاء يوقع شراكة مع الشركة الأساسية (partnership announcement)
source.note: Club announcement: Basic Electronics for Electronic Devices Ltd (Fisher) becomes a main partner, with its logo on the chest of the first team's shirt; the launch photos show the Fisher brand mark. Opened 2026-10-03.

source.name: Al-Fayha Club: الرعاة والشركاء (sponsors and partners page)
source.note: Tameeni (تأميني) listed among current sponsors; on the shirt the blue Tameeni badge sits on the upper chest, visible in the club launch photos and the official-store product photos. Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03.

source.name: Al-Fayha official store: home 2026-27 kit product photos (الطقم الأول البرتقالي 2026-2027 HH)
source.note: Official club store photos of the first (orange) shirt, with the sponsor-print option: the upper back carries 'الرميح / للاستثمارات العقارية' (Al Romaih Real Estate Investments) with its droplet logo above the player name and number; the same logo is on the club's partner page (alfayhasc.com/partner). Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03 (the second/white kit product page shows the same back sponsor).

source.name: Al-Fayha Club: الفيحاء يوقع شراكة مع شركة مستيك «مرح» (partnership announcement)
source.note: Club announcement: the Marah app logo goes on the shoulder (كتف) of the first team's shirt; launch and store photos show the MARAH patch on the right sleeve. Opened 2026-10-03.

source.name: Al-Fayha Club: الفيحاء يوقع عقد رعاية مع شركة «سنتركو» (sponsorship renewal announcement)
source.note: Club announcement: Centrico's logo appears on the lower part (أسفل) of the first team's shirt (second season running). The club's kit-reveal graphics show the centrico mark in a partner strip at the lower front; the replica shirt photos do not carry it. Opened 2026-10-03.

source.name: HH Sport: About Us
source.note: The Kuwaiti kit maker lists Al-Fayha FC among its partner clubs ('proud to have partnered with Al-Fayha FC in Saudi Arabia') and sells the 2026-27 Al-Fayha kits; the shirts carry the HH roundel. Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03.

summary: HH Sport home kit. Fisher (Basic Electronics Company) across the front chest with the blue Tameeni badge above it, Al Romaih Real Estate Investments across the upper back, Marah patched on the right sleeve, the RSL league badge on the left sleeve, and Centrico on the lower front per the club's renewal announcement. Shirts, shorts and socks otherwise carry only the HH maker's mark. Complete: front, back, sleeves, shorts and the lower-front strip were checked against the club's announcements, launch graphics and official-store photos.
